{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

df = df[df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

df = df[df['customer_segment'].isin(['new', 'returning', 'loyal'])]

df_total = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
df_total = df_total.rename(columns={'converted': 'overall_conversion_rate'})
df_total"}
